name: Batchelor Institute VET fee exemptions
provider: Batchelor Institute of Indigenous Tertiary Education
summary: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students at Batchelor Institute pay no VET fees on funded courses; Centrelink recipients and students in hardship can apply for exemptions.
key: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander students enrolled in any VET course are automatically exempt on government-funded courses.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander students enrolled in any VET course (automatic)
Students on full-time ABSTUDY, Austudy or other listed Centrelink benefits (with evidence)
Unemployed students and those who can show financial hardship
how: Provide evidence at enrolment and apply for a fee exemption.
catches: Exemptions are not applied retrospectively unless approved.
Batchelor is no longer approved for VET Student Loans.

evidence.claim: Automatic exemption for First Nations VET students
evidence.quote: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander students enrolled in any VET course.
Special consideration will be given to students who can demonstrate financial hardship.
Fee exemptions are not applied retrospectively, unless approved otherwise.
